About Us

A Sialkot Travel Agency Built on Trust

Al Samar Travel & Tours is based at Cantonment Plaza 2, Ward No. 6, Jamia Masjid Road, Sialkot Cantt, near Allama Iqbal Public School, Sialkot. We started with one belief: travellers from our city deserve the same honest pricing and careful planning as anyone in Lahore or Karachi — without having to travel there to get it.

Today we serve families, groups and solo travellers across Sialkot, Gujranwala, Daska and Wazirabad with Umrah packages, international group tours, visit visas, ticketing and hotels. Most of our clients come through referrals — and we work hard to keep it that way.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I confirm my booking?

Send an enquiry through the form above or on WhatsApp. We confirm availability and total price in writing, then reserve your seat with an advance payment at our Sialkot Cantt office or by bank transfer. You receive a booking receipt for every payment.

What documents do I need for a group tour?

A valid passport (6+ months), CNIC copy and photographs. Visa requirements differ by country — we give you a simple checklist when you book.

Can I customise a package?

Yes. Hotels, dates, room sharing and extra nights can all be adjusted. Tell us your budget and we will build around it honestly.

What is your cancellation policy?

Airline and hotel charges follow the supplier's policy; our service fee portion is refundable up to 15 days before departure. Full terms are shared in writing before you pay anything.
